onboarding.intro: Functional annotation transfers GO terms from proteins of known function to your query sequences. PROTEA encodes each protein into a high-dimensional embedding, runs a KNN search against a reference annotation set, and aggregates the neighbors' GO terms into a ranked prediction per protein. You need three ingredients before launching a job: precomputed embeddings, a reference annotation set, and the query sequences you want to annotate.
onboarding.prereqsHelper: Each step opens its dedicated page so you can build or pick the artefact.

embeddings.title: Embedding model
embeddings.help: A protein language model (PLM) configuration plus its precomputed vectors over your reference proteins. The KNN search runs in this embedding space, so its choice (esm2, prost_t5, ankh, etc.) determines which proteins look similar.
embeddings.emptyLabel: No embedding configuration is registered yet.

annotationSet.title: Reference annotation set
annotationSet.help: The pool of GO annotations you transfer from. Typically a GOA or QuickGO release filtered by evidence code. Neighbors found by KNN must come from this set, so its coverage and freshness directly limit recall.
annotationSet.emptyLabel: No reference annotation set is loaded yet.

querySet.title: Query set
querySet.help: Named bundle of protein sequences you want to annotate. Pick a saved query set to keep the prediction reproducible, or leave it empty to annotate every protein in the database.
querySet.emptyLabel: No saved query sets. You can still annotate all sequences, or upload one.

usagePolicyModal.title: Welcome to PROTEA
usagePolicyModal.subtitle: Personal compute resources, openly shared — please read before continuing
usagePolicyModal.intro: This platform runs on personal hardware shared freely for research purposes. No registration or authorization is required. Please keep the following in mind:
usagePolicyModal.rule1: These are personal resources shared voluntarily. Please be mindful of the load you generate.
usagePolicyModal.rule2: Before launching heavy or long-running jobs, reach out first — a quick message explaining your use case is much appreciated.
usagePolicyModal.rule3: All processed data is public and open. Feel free to use and share results.
usagePolicyModal.rule4: PROTEA is free and open source. Any individual or research institution can deploy their own instance — source code on GitHub.
usagePolicyModal.rule5: This service runs on a best-effort basis. The system may be taken down for maintenance or personal use at any time without prior notice.
usagePolicyModal.rule6: If something breaks or behaves unexpectedly, please report it. Bug reports and feedback are genuinely appreciated.
usagePolicyModal.dataPublicNote: All data processed here is public. Thank you for using this responsibly.
